newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan 21-day NCD average yield at 5.633 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan 21-day NCD average yield at 5.633 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$3 billion in 21-day negotiable certificates of deposit on Wednesday at an average yield of 5.633 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 5.500 and 5.699 percent.

The central bank repeatedly issued NCDs during a sustained stock rally in March and April, a move widely seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling the sizzling stock market.
The central bank has confirmed that it was responding to the liquidity sitution but denied that it was acting directly in response to the stock market bull run.
